verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a built-in FastAPI Swagger UI at /docs on a self-hosted instance, which gives an interactive API reference. However, it only appears when ENV=dev is set, the API reference is labeled experimental, and there is no vendor-hosted playground or downloadable OpenAPI spec (the probe got 404s on every spec path). missing for 10: vendor-hosted interactive reference, documented runnable examples, availability without dev mode, a stable non-experimental API reference, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Make sure to set the `ENV` environment variable to `dev` in order to access the Swagger documentation
Access detailed API documentation for different services provided by Open WebUI
Without this configuration, the documentation will not be available
